weaknesses.title: Sep var name SEP hard-fails SPLITF
weaknesses.detail: DEFAULT SEP="/" then SPLITF obj field SEP → err 'SPLITF object field sep' (halted). Same class as FLOOR/CAP collision for MAXF/MINF. Must use DELIM/S/DIV.
weaknesses.repro: DEFAULT SEP="/"; SPLITF r path SEP → SPLITF object field sep

weaknesses.title: SEGS plate stale after strip without re-split
weaknesses.detail: JOIN reads SEGS.txt written by prior SPLITF; strip mutates path but not SEGS. Join rebuilt pre-strip route while path was post-strip. Agents must invalidate or re-split after path mutators.
weaknesses.repro: split; strip svc/; join → route still full pre-strip bag

weaknesses.title: SYS TAIL may not surface trailing empty segment
weaknesses.detail: path /a/b/ SPLITF N=4 with leading empty; META leaf showed b not empty. Trailing empty segment vs trailing WRITE NL ambiguous for TAIL.

weaknesses.title: Empty ARG2 cannot clear PATHIN (falls to default)
weaknesses.detail: CUBALC_ARG2= with empty string → LAST_N=0 branch; open/setpath keeps DEFAULT PATHIN. Need ENV CUBALC_FS_PATH blank handling or sentinel.
weaknesses.repro: setpath ARG2= empty leaves default path

weaknesses.title: SPLITF non-mutating but JOINF mutates — asymmetric pair
weaknesses.detail: SPLITF leaves field intact (bag in LAST only); JOINF writes field. Agents expecting split to replace path must SETF manually. Documented in proof but easy to misread as in-place split.

weaknesses.title: REQUIRE=abc softens
weaknesses.detail: Non-numeric REQUIRE miss exit 0 on gate deny.
